THE_QUEEN_CARD_SWIPE.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] deals {LearnIntentDamage:diff()} damage and steals that enemy's card. After {AmalgamEscapePower:diff()} turns, your Amalgam flees.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_STEAM_ERUPTION.title: Steam Eruption
THE_QUEEN_CARD_STEAM_ERUPTION.descriptio:

THE_QUEEN_CARD_BECKON.title: Beckon Force
THE_QUEEN_CARD_BECKON.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
At the start of each turn, add a [gold]Beckon[/gold] into your Hand.
At the end of your turn, if there are no [gold]Beckon[/gold] cards in your Hand, gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].

THE_QUEEN_CARD_FLAMETHROWER.title: Flamethrower
THE_QUEEN_CARD_FLAMETHROWER.description:

THE_QUEEN_CARD_SOUL_CALM_CASKET.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target is at or below {HpThresholdPercent:diff()}% HP, double this damage.
On [gold]Fatal[/gold], [gold]Capture[/gold] the target.

THE_QUEEN_CARD_SQUEEZE_BLOOD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has 3 or more debuffs, deal double damage.

THE_QUEEN_CARD_SELF_DESTRUCT.description:
Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] loses all HP, then deals damage equal to the HP lost to ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}

THE_QUEEN_CARD_RELEASE.description:

THE_QUEEN_CARD_MARIONETTE.description: Gain the target's [gold]Monster Card[/gold]. After 3 turns, permanently add that card to your deck.

THE_QUEEN_CARD_FRENZIED_BITE.description: Your [gold]Amalgam[/gold] takes its action {Actions:diff()} times in a row, then [gold]forgets[/gold] all intents.
THE_QUEEN_CARD_EXECUTION.title: Execution
THE_QUEEN_CARD_EXECUTION.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. For each debuff on the target, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.

THE_QUEEN_CARD_QUICK_ADAPTATION.title: Quick Adaptation
THE_QUEEN_CARD_QUICK_ADAPTATION.descript:
Choose {Pick:diff()} [gold]Learn Intent[/gold] card(s) from your draw pile and play them automatically.

{Sandpit:choose(0):Gain {AmalgamSandpitPower:diff()} [gold]Sandpit[/gold].
|}{InCombat:|If this is a Boss fight, gain 10 instead.
